note: 14B evidence now includes AWQ downstream task-retention feasibility plus an AWQ-aware activation/scale CSI proxy over WQLinear_GEMM modules. It is still not a full FP16 fake-quant CSI downstream allocation run.
runtime_caveats: AutoAWQ required a compatibility alias from PytorchGELUTanh to GELUActivation for the installed Transformers version.
awq_ext was not available, so AutoAWQ used its slower fallback implementation.
The result files use quant_mode=fp16 because no additional fake quantization is applied on top of the already-AWQ checkpoint.
These 14B runs do not establish CSI-guided allocation superiority; they establish 14B AWQ task-retention feasibility under the current RTX 3090 environment.
An AWQ-aware activation/scale proxy was added for all 336 WQLinear_GEMM body modules at n64 seed0/seed1; this measures split stability but does not re-quantize weights.

main_findings.claim_boundary: Use as 14B task-retention feasibility plus AWQ-aware calibration-stability proxy evidence, not as complete 14B fake-quant downstream CSI superiority evidence.
main_findings.awq_module_compatibility: Only lm_head is torch.nn.Linear; transformer blocks are WQLinear_GEMM. Full 14B CSI allocation is not supported by the current standard-Linear fake-quant path.
main_findings.awq_activation_csi_proxy: n64 seed0/seed1 over 336 WQLinear_GEMM modules: top-25% Jaccard 0.9765, Spearman 0.9998, avg bits 2.9996 under 2/4-bit proxy allocation.

module_compatibility_probe.implication: The existing CSI sensitivity/allocation scripts target torch.nn.Linear weights; the AWQ body is WQLinear_GEMM without standard .weight tensors, so full 14B CSI allocation requires an AWQ-aware sensitivity path or an FP16 14B checkpoint/offload path.

awq_activation_csi_proxy.claim_boundary: AWQ-aware activation/scale CSI proxy only; not full 14B fake-quant downstream CSI.
